findings.text: The done_when states 'ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings', and neither the manifest nor any log under logs/ records that measurement: test_logs names only gate-head.log, gate-base.log, negative-control.log, suite-head.log and suite-base.log, so one clause of the node's own gate is asserted in the brief and claimed nowhere a reader can re-run. The reformatting itself is visible in 0e83c9c69a (a dict comprehension split across lines and a doubled blank line removed in promotion_records.py), which is the effect of the clause rather than the evidence for it.

The table's 'only one of command and log given' row states its base arm as 'promoted, mixing the two', but logs/gate-base.log records that outcome for the command-without-log half only ('DID NOT RAISE CrewError'); the log-without-command half is refused at base by promotion_gate._require_executable_gate_command on the JSON-list tests line, so it is not promoted and the cell describes one of the row's two cases as both.

The paragraph states that removing the total derivation 'leaves ['total'] as the missing measure and fails the derived-total case', but the only control recorded is logs/negative-control.log, whose header names a single mutation ('gate derivation removed') and whose two failures are case 1 and case 2 at promotion_gate.py:304; no log in the run records the total-derivation removal, so the second half of the 'each derivation is load-bearing' claim is unmeasured in this record.
